description: The words spoken in an audio or video file, with timings: a meeting, a lecture, a voice message. Vietnamese, English and about 100 other languages, found by itself or named. Up to 20 minutes a file; split a longer one. Free, 10 files a day per account. The sound is sent to Cloudflare's speech model to be written down and is not kept there.

file_id.description: The file_id from get_upload_link, once the user has uploaded the audio or video file (MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, FLAC, WebM or MP4, up to 20 minutes) there.

file_url.description: Or a public https link to the audio or video file (MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, FLAC, WebM or MP4, up to 20 minutes). A result link from another YangOpen tool works too.

language.description: Optional language code like vi or en. Default: found from the sound.

name: audio_to_text
title: Write down what is said in a recording
